name: aegispay
description: AegisPay Autonomous Agentic Escrow & Dual-Engine Clearinghouse MCP Server

tools.name: aegispay_propose_agreement
tools.description: Autonomous buyer agent tool to propose an SLA contract and lock escrow funds via PayPal authorization hold.

buyer_agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the buyer agent initiating the task

worker_agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the worker agent hired to solve the task

worker_paypal_email.description: PayPal receiver email for final settlement payout

budget_micros.description: Agreed escrow budget in integer micro-dollars ($1.00 USD = 1,000,000 micros)

task_description.description: Detailed task description and SLA specifications

timeout_seconds.description: Execution TTL in seconds before contract authorization expires

vault_id.description: Optional PayPal Vault payment method token for autonomous pre-authorized billing

tools.name: aegispay_submit_deliverable
tools.description: Autonomous worker agent tool to submit completed code deliverable and test suite to the air-gapped verification arbiter.

agreement_id.description: The SLA agreement identifier under which deliverable is submitted

test_suite.description: Buyer validation unit test suite (pytest format)

tools.name: aegispay_check_escrow_status
tools.description: Query active agreement state, composite arbitration score, and double-entry settlement ledger status.

agreement_id.description: Unique SLA contract agreement identifier to query
